invariants.rationale: The method operates on a timeline instant identified by instantTime, so it is expected not to be null.
The method will likely need a non-null list of keys to process deletes.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is typically required to execute table operations.
If keys is not null, the method likely expects it to contain at least one HoodieKey for deletion.
A non-empty instantTime string is required to identify the operation's point in time.
